page_title: WOL 3-0 DAR | Wolfsburg v Darmstadt 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' 3 - 0 Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
90+2' Here's the change. Lovro Majer leaves the pitch and Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Some great controlled play and passing from Darmstadt. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
85' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Asaf Arania (Darmstadt) replaces Emir Karic.
85' Here comes a substitution. Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt) is brought on as a substitute for Julian Justvan.
84' 5:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) is coming onto the pitch as Kevin Paredes cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Here is a change. Jonas Wind is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
79' A pass by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
77' The linesman points to the corner flag, Darmstadt are going to take it.
75' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
74' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

74' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down. Robert Hartmann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
66' Substitution. Patrick Wimmer makes his way off the pitch and Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
65' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Ridle Baku and he is replaced by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
64' The resulting corner, taken by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg), comes to nothing.
63' A quickly taken corner by Wolfsburg.

62' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Alexander Brunst. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) is replacing Oscar Vilhelmsson.
60' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
58' Darmstadt string together a series of short passes.
56' 60:40 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
52' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt), but the defence gets it clear.
49' Wolfsburg players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
47' Darmstadt concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
46' Torsten Lieberknecht makes a half-time substitution. Aaron Seydel comes on in place of Andreas Muller (Darmstadt).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:1.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The referee points to the corner flag and Darmstadt will take a corner.
44' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
43' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar.
42' The referee blows his whistle, Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
41' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
40' The total number of attempts is 6:1.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.
37' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' It is time for a substitution. Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) is on for Matej Maglica.
33' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Alexander Brunst to dive and make a save.
32' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) gets a yellow card.
30' Wolfsburg keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
28' A player from Darmstadt commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
26' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 68:32.
24' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Alexander Brunst easily deals with the threat.
23' Wolfsburg are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
21' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Hartmann blows for a foul.
19' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
18' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
16' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Darmstadt was in an offside position.
14' It looks like Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) saw red with that tackle. Robert Hartmann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
13' Darmstadt keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

11' 2 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
7' Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
6' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

2' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.
